Pronunciation fixtures were retrieved on 2026-10-23 from:

- https://api.wiktapi.dev/v1/en/word/standard?lang=en (sounds only)
- https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/standard (English pronunciation section)
- https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/greetings (English pronunciation section)

WiktAPI exposes Wiktionary data. Wiktionary text is available under CC BY-SA:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Audio files retain their individual Wikimedia Commons licenses; the fixtures
contain links rather than copies of the recordings.
